prompt: automake parallel make recovery locking portable test-and-set command
answer:
The portable test-and-set command is:

```sh
if mkdir data.lock 2>/dev/null; then
    # First process: rebuild
    rm -f data.stamp
    $(MAKE) $(AM_MAKEFLAGS) data.stamp
    result=$?
    rm -rf data.lock
    exit $result
else
    # Follower processes: wait
    while test -d data.lock; do sleep 1; done
    test -f data.stamp
fi
```

Automake’s manual identifies `mkdir` as a “portable test-and-set.” The lock directory is created by only one process; others wait until it disappears.
